Group CHRO search: talent mapping for CXOs

Problem: find a Group CHRO for a large listed, promoter-led Indian solar manufacturer that is scaling plants fast. I mapped 10 target companies across three talent pools, built a framework of seven weighted parameters with four knock-out criteria, and scored two illustrative candidates from public information. They trade off differently: one leads on building manufacturing HR, the other on scale and HR pedigree. The plan runs about 12 weeks from calibration to offer.
